verses.text: तपःस्वाध्यायनिरतं तपस्वी वाग्विदां वरम् । नारदं परिपप्रच्छ वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुंगवम् ॥
verses.english: The ascetic Vālmīki asked Nārada, who was devoted to austerity and Vedic recitation, the best of those who know speech, the bull among sages.
verses.gold_issues: निरतम् lemma given as निरम्; root is रम् with preverb नि.

verses.text: को न्वस्मिन्साम्प्रतं लोके गुणवान्कश्च वीर्यवान् । धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च सत्यवाक्यो दृढव्रतः ॥
verses.english: Who now in this world is virtuous, and who is valorous, and knowing dharma, and grateful, truthful in speech [and] firm in vows?

verses.text: चारित्रेण च को युक्तः सर्वभूतेषु को हितः । विद्वान्कः कः समर्थश्च कश्चैकप्रियदर्शनः ॥
verses.english: And who is endowed with good conduct, who is beneficial to all beings, who is learned, who is capable, and who is uniquely pleasing to behold?
verses.gold_issues: युक्तः taken as participial predicate (क्रिया); could equally be विधेय>2 like the other epithets.

verses.text: आत्मवान्को जितक्रोधो मतिमान्को ऽनसूयकः । कस्य बिभ्यति देवाश्च जातरोषस्य संयुगे ॥
verses.english: Who is self-possessed, who has conquered anger, who is wise [and] free from envy; and of whom, his anger roused in battle, are the gods afraid?
verses.gold_issues: कस्य is the feared one with भी in the genitive (अपादान sense).

verses.text: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे । महर्षे त्वं समर्थो ऽसि ज्ञातुमेवंविधं नरम् ॥
verses.english: I wish to hear this, for my curiosity is great; O great sage, you are able to know such a man.
verses.gold_issues: परम् is Nom here (DCS correct); taken as predicate of the verbless clause, not attributive.

verses.text: श्रुत्वा चैतत्त्रिलोकज्ञो वाल्मीकेर्नारदो वचः । श्रूयतामिति चामन्त्र्य प्रहृष्टो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.english: And having heard this speech of Vālmīki, Nārada, knower of the three worlds, delighted, having addressed [him] with "Listen!", spoke [these] words.

verses.text: बहवो दुर्लभाश्चैव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः । मुने वक्ष्याम्यहं बुद्ध्वा तैर्युक्तः श्रूयतां नरः ॥
verses.english: O sage, the many and indeed rare qualities which have been proclaimed by you — having considered [them] I shall tell; let the man endowed with them be heard [of].

verses.text: इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः । नियतात्मा महावीर्यो द्युतिमान्धृतिमान्वशी ॥
verses.english: Sprung from the Ikṣvāku lineage, self-controlled, of great valour, radiant, steadfast, self-mastered, [one] named Rāma is heard of by the people.

verses.text: बुद्धिमान्नीतिमान्वाग्मी श्रीमाञ्शत्रुनिबर्हणः । विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवो महाहनुः ॥
verses.english: [He is] intelligent, versed in policy, eloquent, glorious, destroyer of enemies, broad-shouldered, mighty-armed, conch-necked, large-jawed.

verses.text: महोरस्को महेष्वासो गूढजत्रुररिंदमः । आजानुबाहुः सुशिराः सुललाटः सुविक्रमः ॥
verses.english: [He is] broad-chested, a great archer, with hidden collar-bones, subduer of foes, with arms reaching to the knees, with a fine head, a fine forehead [and] fine stride.
verses.gold_issues: आजानु and सु are tagged as free ADV, not as compound members; they are first members of bahuvrīhis.

verses.text: समः समविभक्ताङ्गः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान् । पीनवक्षा विशालाक्षो लक्ष्मीवाञ्शुभलक्षणः ॥
verses.english: [He is] well-proportioned, with evenly divided limbs, of glossy complexion, powerful, full-chested, large-eyed, prosperous, with auspicious marks.

verses.text: धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंधश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः । यशस्वी ज्ञानसम्पन्नः शुचिर्वश्यः समाधिमान् ॥
verses.english: [He is] knower of dharma, true to his promise, and devoted to the welfare of the subjects, famous, endowed with knowledge, pure, self-controlled, possessed of concentration.
verses.gold_issues: रतः/सम्पन्नः kept as epithets (विधेय) rather than participial predicates (क्रिया).

verses.text: रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य परिरक्षिता । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो धनुर्वेदे च निष्ठितः ॥

compounds.vigraha: वेदानां वेदाङ्गानां च तत्त्वं जानाति इति

verses.english: [He is] protector of the world of living beings, guardian of dharma, knower of the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and well-grounded in the science of archery.
verses.gold_issues: जीवलोकस्य, धर्मस्य are object-genitives of the agent nouns रक्षितृ/परिरक्षितृ (सम्बन्ध).

compounds.vigraha: सर्वेषां शास्त्राणाम् अर्थानां तत्त्वं जानाति इति

verses.english: [He is] knower of the true sense of all the śāstras, possessed of memory, quick-witted, dear to all people, good, of undejected spirit, discerning.
verses.gold_issues: अ (नञ्) tagged as free PART, not as compound member.

verses.text: सर्वदाभिगतः सद्भिः समुद्र इव सिन्धुभिः । आर्यः सर्वसमश्चैव सदैकप्रियदर्शनः ॥
verses.english: [He is] always approached by the good, as the ocean [is] by rivers; noble, equal toward all, and ever uniquely pleasing to behold.
verses.gold_issues: simile is elliptical: समुद्रः/सिन्धुभिः attached to अभिगतः as the compared object/agent.
